samples.summary: A family-style, multi-cuisine restaurant plan covering market opportunity, service operations, marketing, and financial forecasts.
key_deliverables: Menu positioning, operations, and marketing plan
samples.detail_summary: This demonstration sample turns a family-style, multi-cuisine restaurant concept into a complete operating and growth plan. It covers market opportunity, customer segments, menu positioning, service operations, marketing, and financial forecasts. It demonstrates how a hospitality idea can be prepared for practical decision-making and funding conversations.
samples.title: XYZ Restaurant

samples.summary: A two-villa vacation-rental plan for the Turks and Caicos Islands, covering guest segments, positioning, operations, and funding.
key_deliverables: Property offer, operations, and marketing strategy
samples.detail_summary: This confidentiality-safe sample develops a two-villa vacation-rental concept for the Turks and Caicos Islands. It defines the guest segments, property offer, market position, operating model, marketing strategy, and financial plan needed to move the development from concept to funding discussion. It demonstrates end-to-end property and hospitality planning.
samples.title: Marina Villa TCI

samples.summary: A financing-ready seafood business plan developed for a client in the Turks and Caicos Islands, covering market demand, capacity, operations, and funding.
samples.detail_summary: This confidentiality-safe sample was developed for a client in the Turks and Caicos Islands. It shows how market demand, customer segments, operational capacity, and funding requirements can be brought together in a financing-ready seafood business plan. It demonstrates research, commercial planning, operational strategy, and financial modelling.
samples.title: ABC Fishing Company

samples.summary: A Turks and Caicos restaurant plan connecting local-cuisine positioning, guest needs, operations, and financial forecasts.

It brings together customer research, local-cuisine positioning, site and operations planning, marketing, staffing, and financial forecasts. It demonstrates how a hospitality idea can be shaped into a practical, investor-ready plan.

samples.summary: A regulated indoor cannabis cultivation plan for Massachusetts, combining licensing, operations, market strategy, and financial forecasts.
samples.detail_summary: This demonstration sample develops a regulated indoor cannabis cultivation venture in Massachusetts. It joins licensing and compliance considerations with cultivation operations, target-market analysis, go-to-market planning, and multi-year financial forecasts. It demonstrates planning for a complex, regulation-led market.
samples.title: XYZ Cannabis

samples.summary: A two-phase sustainable housing proposal for the Caribbean, combining property mix, delivery strategy, sustainability, and financial forecasts.
key_deliverables: Multi-year financial forecasts and funding plan
samples.detail_summary: This public sample sets out a two-phase sustainable housing development in the Caribbean for long-term renters and first-time homeowners. It connects housing needs, property mix, sustainability features, site planning, delivery strategy, and multi-year financial forecasts. It demonstrates how a complex real-estate proposal can be organised for financing and execution.
samples.title: SRDL

samples.summary: A mobile-first cross-border payments plan for Africa and its diaspora, linking user needs, product strategy, security, and growth.
samples.detail_summary: This public sample outlines a mobile-first fintech concept for lower-cost cross-border payments between Africa and its diaspora. It brings together user research, remittance-market analysis, product architecture, security, growth strategy, and funding forecasts. It demonstrates strategic planning for a technology-led financial service.
